map.在安静环境戴上耳机，系统在各频率（如 250Hz~8kHz）播放由弱到强的纯音，: In a quiet room put on headphones; the system plays pure tones from soft to loud at each frequency (such as 250Hz to 8kHz), and you press the button as soon as you hear it. Your thresholds are recorded per frequency and joined into an audiogram so you can see your hearing curve quickly. This screening does not replace a professional audiometry test.
map.阈值的升/降法自动定位: The ascending and descending method locates the threshold automatically
map.左右耳分别测试: Test the left and right ears separately
map.自我筛查：留意是否某频率听不清: Self-screening: notice whether any frequency is hard to hear
map.护耳参考：长期噪声暴露后复测: Hearing protection reference: retest after long-term noise exposure
map.科普了解：直观看到听力曲线: Understand it by seeing: an intuitive view of the hearing curve
map.戴上耳机，调好舒适音量，环境尽量安静: Put on headphones, set a comfortable volume, and keep the environment as quiet as possible
map.逐频率点击播放，听到就按听到了: Play each frequency in turn and press as soon as you hear it
map.系统确定该频率听阈后进入下一频率: Once the threshold at that frequency is set, the system moves to the next frequency
map.左右耳分别完成后查看听力图: Finish the left and right ears separately, then view the audiogram
map.对比既往结果看变化趋势: Compare with past results to see the trend
map.务必用耳机且在安静处测，外放会严重失真: Always use headphones in a quiet room; speaker playback distorts the result badly
map.感冒鼻塞时中耳受压，结果会偏差: With a cold and a blocked nose the middle ear pressure changes and the results are biased
map.高频（4k/8k）下降常见于噪损，属预警: A decline at high frequencies (4k/8k) is common in noise damage and is an early warning
map.本结果仅作参考，耳闷或突聋请就医: This result is for reference only; seek care for ear fullness or sudden hearing loss

map.仅覆盖纯音听阈，不排除听辨、耳鸣等其他问题，异常感受仍应就医。: It covers only the pure-tone hearing threshold and does not rule out other problems such as speech discrimination or tinnitus, so seek care if you notice anything abnormal.
